rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs (English translation)
rules.source_excerpt: A sponsor shall indicate the following information in the Japanese language on the container or package of the investigational products
rules.notes: Focused evidence slice based on MHLW's English translation; qualified users must verify the Japanese text and applicability before real-trial use.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(1)
rules.source_excerpt: 第十六条　治験依頼者は、治験薬の容器又は被包に次に掲げる事項（拡大治験を実施する場合にあっては、第一号及び第二号に掲げる事項に限る。）を邦文で記載しなければならない。 一　治験用である旨 二　治験依頼者の氏名及び住所 三　化学名又は識別記号 四　製造番号又は製造記号 五　貯蔵方法、有効期間等を定める必要があるものについては、その内容
rules.notes: Imported from the current official Japanese text. The normalized English field mapping and applicability date require qualified review; expanded-access trials have a narrower field set.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(2)
rules.source_excerpt: 一　予定される販売名 二　予定される効能又は効果 三　予定される用法又は用量
rules.notes: Article 16(2) includes exceptions for open-label investigational products and expanded-access trials; qualified review is required before acceptance.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(1)(ii)
rules.source_excerpt: 当該者が本邦内に住所を有しない場合にあっては、その氏名及び住所地の国名並びに治験国内管理人の氏名及び住所
rules.notes: The English normalization of 治験国内管理人 is intentionally review-gated.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(3)
rules.source_excerpt: 緊急時に、治験責任医師等が被験薬及び対照薬の識別を直ちにできるよう必要な措置を講じておかなければならない。
rules.notes: Applies to blinded investigational products supplied to the institution.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(4)
rules.source_excerpt: 輸送及び保存中の汚染や劣化を防止するため治験薬を包装して実施医療機関に交付しなければならない。
rules.notes: Qualitative packaging control only; this does not establish a packaging duration or temperature range.

rules.source_title: MHLW: Ministerial Ordinance on Good Clinical Practice for Drugs, Article 16(5)-(7)
rules.source_excerpt: 治験薬又は治験使用薬に関する次に掲げる記録を作成しなければならない。 六　治験依頼者は、治験の契約の締結後遅滞なく、実施医療機関における治験使用薬の管理に関する手順書を作成し、これを実施医療機関に交付しなければならない。
rules.notes: These are investigational-product control records and procedures, not import-permit documents. Article 16(7) makes handling instructions conditional on need.

events.title: Japan · additional label field
events.description: A simulated local-contact field conflicts with the shared booklet; artwork review adds 5 business days.
events.source_excerpt: SIMULATED EVENT: A simulated local-contact field conflicts with the shared booklet; artwork review adds 5 business days.

repair_options.title: Separate Japan's label
repair_options.description: Isolate the new field and use a pre-reviewed local artwork; 1 day rework applies only to Japan.
repair_options.tradeoffs: One separate artwork and additional review coordination.

repair_options.title: Expedite shared review
repair_options.description: Reduce shared artwork review to 2 additional business days.
repair_options.tradeoffs: Premium review effort across all members of the original group.

events.title: Germany · severe weather on Boston–Frankfurt

repair_options.title: Reroute through Amsterdam
repair_options.description: Use the unaffected Boston–Amsterdam lane and qualified ground transport to the German depot to recover the delivery window.
repair_options.tradeoffs: Higher transportation cost proxy and an additional cross-border ground leg.
